description: How a failure becomes the error message and the exit code. kind refusal is a startup refusal with a category, a subject, a reason and an optional hint; one_shot marks a refusal from a command that starts no long-running process; wrap is text placed before the whole message by an outer error. kind unavailable is a failure to produce the requested report, used by agent doctor. kind error is any other failure. wgft prints "Error: " followed by message on stderr.

cases.name: config refusal of agent run
cases.subject: WGFT_MODE
cases.reason: must be kernel or userspace, not "x"
cases.message: refusing to start [config WGFT_MODE]: must be kernel or userspace, not "x"

cases.name: the same refusal from a command that starts nothing
cases.subject: WGFT_MODE
cases.reason: must be kernel or userspace, not "x"
cases.message: cannot continue [config WGFT_MODE]: must be kernel or userspace, not "x"

cases.name: prerequisite
cases.subject: CAP_NET_ADMIN
cases.message: refusing to start [prerequisite CAP_NET_ADMIN]: kernel mode needs CAP_NET_ADMIN

cases.name: conflict
cases.subject: WGFT_JOIN
cases.reason: this join string is already used; issue a new join string
cases.message: refusing to start [conflict WGFT_JOIN]: this join string is already used; issue a new join string

cases.name: mode gate
cases.subject: WGFT_MODE
cases.message: refusing to start [mode-gate WGFT_MODE]: run wgft agent teardown first

cases.name: no subject
cases.message: refusing to start [prerequisite]: this build has no server

cases.name: hint is a separate sentence
cases.subject: /etc/wgft/agent.env
cases.reason: open /etc/wgft/agent.env: permission denied; this process runs as uid 998, gid 998, and the file is mode 0600 with owner uid 0 and group gid 0
cases.hint: It may hold WGFT_JOIN, so let the agent's group read it
cases.message: refusing to start [config /etc/wgft/agent.env]: open /etc/wgft/agent.env: permission denied; this process runs as uid 998, gid 998, and the file is mode 0600 with owner uid 0 and group gid 0. It may hold WGFT_JOIN, so let the agent's group read it

cases.name: refusal wrapped in another error keeps exit code 3
cases.subject: WGFT_JOIN
cases.message: re-register failed: refusing to start [conflict WGFT_JOIN]: registration rejected

cases.name: any other failure
cases.reason: credentials file is in use by another process
cases.message: credentials file is in use by another process
